findings.problem: Both branches of the case split end with the same two steps: destructure a witness `⟨c, hc⟩` with `hc : algebraMap C _ c = φ (X 0)`, then convert it with `coordinate_sub_constant_mem_prime Q 0 c hc`. Because of this repetition, the proof never states its real intermediate goal, that `φ (X 0)` is a constant of the residue field. The reader has to work that out by comparing the two branches. The proof also names the dichotomy `hd` and destructures it on the next line, and binds `let q` only to use it once.
findings.proposed_change:
Factor out the shared conversion with `suffices` and destructure the dichotomy directly:
```lean
  let φ := polynomialResidueMap Q
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType C (PolynomialResidueField Q) :=
    polynomialResidueField_essFiniteType Q
  suffices ∃ c : C, algebraMap C (PolynomialResidueField Q) c = φ (X 0) by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := this
    exact ⟨c, coordinate_sub_constant_mem_prime Q 0 c hc⟩
  rcases normal_basis_differential_dichotomy m (φ (X 0)) hy (primeNormalProjection Q)
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) hq hexclude with hzero | ⟨i, hlog⟩
  · have hD : KaehlerDifferential.D C (PolynomialResidueField Q) (φ (X 0)) = 0 :=
      differential_eq_zero_of_polynomialTangent φ Q
        (polynomialResidueMap_eq_zero Q) 0 (fun t ht =>
          hzero t ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ht))
    exact constant_of_differential_eq_zero (φ (X 0)) hD
  · exact constant_of_prime_polynomialTangent Q i.succ 0
      (fun t ht => hlog t ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ht))
```
The `have : Algebra.EssFiniteType ...` line can probably be removed as well (see review notes).
findings.benefit: The proof now shows its outline directly: reduce to "`φ (X 0)` is a constant" once, then show that each case of the dichotomy gives this. One case uses a vanishing differential, the other a logarithmic-differential relation. The named step `hD` is kept, so the mathematical content is just as visible. The duplicated `obtain`/`exact` pair and the single-use `hd`/`q` bindings go away, and no automation is added.
